scope: One bounded fresh-family local study using existing Qwen 7B and Llama 3B; no training, download or paid API.
scientific_question: Does a pre-question, sentence-final event-state patch carry person B's Agent status across active/passive syntax and B-first/B-second surface position, more selectively than a positional or generic answer donor?
system: Answer the question about the sentence. Reply with only the person's name.
question: Who {verb} someone?
competence_gate: Before any hidden-state capture or patching, both models must pass full-name greedy and teacher-forced candidate scoring on all seven conditions in at least one development and one evaluation family each. All four families are reported; no replacement. The unrelated condition uses question 'Who photographed someone?'. Reuse the scorer already validated 8/8 on exposed prompts for each model, with no code change.
primary_patch_site: Sentence-final period token, before the question in the causal stream. This token has seen the complete event but cannot see the question. Patch the block-output residual at that token within each model.
wrong_site: The 'Sentence:' prefix token preceding both participant names; patch the donor's corresponding prefix-token state into the recipient prefix as a generic-disruption control.
recipient: receiver_cleft_a_agent, whose correct Agent is A; score logP(B)-logP(A) using complete name sequences after each patch.
controls: recipient self patch at primary site
all four factorial donors at wrong site
same-answer unrelated donor at primary site
main_contrasts: At each layer, e_d = patched B-vs-A full-name margin minus self-patch margin. Role contrast D=mean(e_BAgentActive,e_BAgentPassive)-mean(e_BPatientActive,e_BPatientPassive). First-name-position contrast P=mean(e_BAgentActive,e_BPatientPassive)-mean(e_BAgentPassive,e_BPatientActive). Voice contrast V=mean(active donors)-mean(passive donors). Report all raw effects. Same-answer unrelated donor is a diagnostic for event specificity, not automatically a failed role-transfer control.
development_gate: For each model, average D over the three frozen layers and all competent development families. Continue to evaluation patching only if D>0.5 nats and D exceeds abs(P) at the primary site, while the wrong-site D is smaller than half the primary-site D. If either model fails, stop without evaluation patches. This is a selective feasibility criterion, not a population hypothesis test.
evaluation_success: On every competent held-out evaluation family in both models, layer-averaged primary-site D must be positive and larger than abs(P), and wrong-site D must be smaller than half primary-site D. Report failures, individual layers and unrelated-donor effects. A pass supports bounded role-conditioned event-state transport, not a unique internal role-binding algorithm.
stop_rules: No prompt, item, role, site, layer, scorer, threshold or control changes after new-family outputs. If the competence or development gate fails, stop; do not run evaluation patches. No adaptive extra experiments in this run.
